author: EDJM9
body:
A map made by EDJM9, imeme_, and LeftSide

Creators: EDJM9
Helpers: imeme_, LeftSide
Server Host: alexanderjoe

This is a factory themed DTC / DTM. There is one core in the center of the map and one emerald monument.Under the map there is a connected sewer system that players can run through. There are a few secrets that you can find along the map :) Defending on this map is vital, as there are so many ways to rush the objectives.

http://imgur.com/a/VZy0Q

replies.author: EDJM9
replies.body: People arent allowed to build on the walls or build above the map. Players aren't aloud to break / destroy ceiling and walls, and they also arent able to build under the map. Kinda like the map "Illegal Office," except you cant build outside. XML magicccc. Indoor maps, there arent many of them, so i decided to make one.
